categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business segments are advanced ceramic material components and surface treatment services. The company manufactures and sells advanced ceramic zero parts for semiconductors, display panels, LED manufacturing, photovoltaic manufacturing, and other industries. Additionally, it provides surface treatment services including cleaning and regeneration services for display panel manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses a complete advanced ceramic material production process from material formulation to component manufacturing. Core technologies include: material formula systems covering six types of ceramics (alumina, zirconia, aluminum nitride, silicon carbide, yttria, and titania); precision machining of hard-brittle materials; and surface treatment methods including precision cleaning, anodizing, and thermal spraying. The company has mastered integrated manufacturing capabilities for functional-structural modular products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading semiconductor equipment manufacturers (North China CNC, Micro Semiconductor, Tuojing Technology), semiconductor wafer manufacturers, display panel manufacturers (BOE, TCL Huaxing, Tianma Microelectronics), LED manufacturers (Sanan Optoelectronics), and automotive manufacturers (BMW Brilliance, Schaeffler, Faurecia). The company serves semiconductor, display panel, LED, photovoltaic, lithium battery, automotive, textile, and pharmaceutical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing bases in Suzhou, Sichuan, and Anhui. It serves both domestic and international markets, with domestic sales accounting for approximately 87.72% of revenue and international sales approximately 12.28%. The company has established production facilities in multiple regions to serve major customer clusters.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures advanced ceramic components and provides surface treatment services for semiconductor equipment manufacturers and display panel manufacturers. The company sources raw materials (ceramic powders) from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components to equipment manufacturers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: developing functional-structural integrated modular products (ceramic heaters, electrostatic chucks, ultra-high-purity silicon carbide kits); advancing semiconductor equipment component localization; expanding production capacity through new manufacturing bases; and enhancing surface treatment capabilities. R&D focuses on high-temperature materials, precision manufacturing, and process optimization for advanced semiconductor applications.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) direct sales of advanced ceramic material components to equipment manufacturers and end-users, accounting for approximately 89.60% of revenue; (2) surface treatment services for display panel equipment, accounting for approximately 9.57% of revenue; and (3) sales of metal structural components and other services. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance or delivery of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international companies such as Kyocera, NGK Insulators, Japan Special Ceramics, and CoorsTek. The company positions itself as a leading domestic advanced ceramic materials enterprise, with competitive advantages in cost, response speed, and localization. The company has achieved import substitution in several key products and maintains strong relationships with major domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 857.38 million yuan, representing 78.45% growth from 480.45 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 310.97 million yuan in 2024, compared to 81.86 million yuan in 2023, representing 279.88% growth. Total assets reached 1.97 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 45.75% from 1.35 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation includes: (1) mastery of complete advanced ceramic manufacturing processes from material formulation to precision machining; (2) development of high-difficulty functional-structural integrated products addressing semiconductor industry bottlenecks; (3) achievement of import substitution in key products such as high-purity alumina and high-thermal-conductivity aluminum nitride components; (4) comprehensive quality management and rapid customer response capabilities; and (5) cost advantages compared to international competitors while maintaining international-level technical standards.
